title: Korean-Style Stew with Gosari
description: A hearty and flavorful Korean-inspired stew made with gosari, a type of Korean mushroom, and a variety of vegetables and spices.

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: such as sesame or peanut oil

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the gosari and cook until it starts to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the gochujang, soy sauce, and sugar (if using), and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the gosari is tender.
Stir in the sesame oil (if using) and season with salt to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds (if desired).
Serve over a bed of quenched rice.
Optional: add other vegetables, such as zucchini or carrots, to the stew for added flavor and nutrition.
